name: tacam-hud
description: TacAM HUD – CS2 broadcast HUD and HUD manager

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tacam/shared && concurrently -n server,hud,control -c red,blue,green "npm run dev -w @tacam/server" "npm run dev -w @tacam/hud" "npm run dev -w @tacam/control"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tacam/shared && npm run build -w @tacam/hud && npm run build -w @tacam/control && npm run build -w @tacam/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @tacam/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @tacam/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tacam/shared && npm run build -w @tacam/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
